🟢 **os-steve** — `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE`, seated 2026-10-06T13:59Z on the maintainer's `/pm-dispatch skills` in this session; round-open marker 6017926700 (R1, now fully closed out). ## Notes

- Job description: `references/lanes/skills.md`. Write paths (verified this shift): `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` (`--repo=owner/name`; `--ack-through=ID` for body refreshes), `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (`--add`/`--remove`, labels on PRs too, by PR number), `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` (`--title-file` / `--body-file` / `--label`), `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file` (`issue_patch`, `comment_edit`, `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`, `pr_request_reviewers`); route `dispatch`; ⛔ no MCP write. Bare REST per `rest-channel.md:49`: `PUT .../pulls/{n}/update-branch` (used once; the merge commit it made is authored by the seat's personal account — the defect #22052 records). CI re-runs: MCP `actions_run_trigger rerun_failed_jobs` answers 201 for the seat (REST 403).
- Landing: Tier S = at-tier `## Contract review` PASS in seat, then `check-expected-skips --pr N` exit 0 + `check-governed-merges --pr N` exit 3 reading Tier S, then the relay flip; `check-governed-merges` also reads the 5000-line human-merge threshold. The ready flip re-triggers the label-sensitive `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, so a PR with auto-merge armed enqueues only after that re-run completes — expected, not a failed arm. A Tier H PR may be flipped ready and armed by the approving human; the seat's close-out (label strips, card reconciliation, checkout) is unchanged.
- Predecessor-dependent PR (landing-operations §C), as practised on #22002: the body carries the expected-red list and the release condition; after the predecessor merges, one `update-branch`, then a successor `## Contract review` naming the new head (the diff compared +/− line by line; `index` blob ids may move when `main` edited the same files elsewhere), then the Tier terminal continues; when every check is green the parked section becomes a synced note.
- Liveness baseline measured this shift (`mode:subagent`, S/M governed-text cards): dispatch → draft PR 32 / 35 / 49 minutes; the 45-minute probe threshold held without a probe. Queue latency observed: enqueue → MERGED 27, 24 and 34 minutes.
- Platform readings this shift: (1) a relay `issue_patch` carrying `body` on a PR number stores the bytes identical — no footer appended; (2) `Validate Package Dependencies` is path-filtered — a PR that only removes a `package.json` `scripts` line triggers it and inherited `main`'s OSV red (#22013, fixed by #22016); (3) a type-check lane could be cancelled at `Checkout repository` by a ten-minute wall with no test body run (#22020, fixed by #22033; root cause, the all-refs fetch, is #22034); (4) `pm:seat` `list_issues` with `body` in `fields` overflows the tool result, and MCP multi-label `list_issues` is a union — REST `labels=a,b` for AND; (5) a shell variable holding backticked text expands them when double-quoted — claim text goes through files, never variables; (6) `gh api --paginate` breaks through the proxy (the `Link` header's `/repositories/{id}` form is refused, HTTP 403) — loop `&page=N` and stop on the RAW page length, because filtering PRs out of an issues page shrinks it below 100 and ends the loop early; (7) `gh api --jq .body` appends one newline — strip it before a whole-body `issue_patch`, or the stored body grows a newline per edit.
- Timers: Routine `trig_01AGpv4wMw88KexCH41wPrGH`; every accelerator of this shift is spent (the last, `trig_01ExXzkiW2RhU5RRFA9NXLHM`, fired at 2026-10-07T04:56Z and filed #22059 and #22060). Standby relies on the Routine; no PR subscription is live.
